evals.prompt: Add a Tabs MDX component so wiki pages can show apt vs dnf commands side by side.
evals.expected_output: Creates components/mdx/tabs.tsx (client component only if it needs state), registers it in mdxComponents in app/pages/[[...slug]]/page.tsx, adds Tabs to MDX_COMPONENTS in the check-content script, documents it in WIKI.md Custom Components and the tech-content-authoring skill, notes blog posts cannot use it, and runs tsc, lint and build with output.

evals.prompt: The sidebar should show a 'new' badge on pages updated in the last 30 days.
evals.expected_output: Edits the live sidebar (components/app-sidebar.tsx and app-sidebar-nav.tsx, fed by buildNavTree in lib/wiki.ts). Adds updatedAt or publishedAt to NavNode in lib/wiki.ts, computes the date at build time on the server, and runs the CI checks. Asks whether to use updatedAt or publishedAt if unclear.

evals.prompt: Wiki pages show up in Google with localhost URLs. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Traces canonical, OG and sitemap URLs to NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL with the localhost fallback used in each route and metadataBase in app/layout.tsx. Concludes that the production build lacked the env var (Vercel project env, pulled by vercel pull in CI) and does not hard-code the domain. Gives the verification: build with the var set and check the canonical tag and the sitemap.
